headline: Zambia: ZCCM-IH plans 2.7 billion dollars of investment over ten years in mines and electricity
summary: Zambia's state-owned ZCCM Investment Holdings plans to invest $2.7 billion over ten years in mining, metals trading and electricity generation. The programme supports a goal of lifting annual copper output to 3 million tonnes.
why: ZCCM-IH is the state investment vehicle holding stakes in Zambia's copper sector, and copper is a key export and industrial metal. Investment plans signal future supply and state-owned sector strategy.
original_headline: Zambie : ZCCM-IH prévoit 2,7 milliards de dollars d’investissements sur dix ans dans les mines et l’électricité
